description: Confirms that TTS picks the voice from the live voice catalog (voice list pagination), saves the tts draft with --voice-name only (never --model, no --count), and hands paid execution and download to their owner skills.
expectations: voiceName comes from the live voice list payload, never reused from old conversations
The tts draft uses --mode tts --voice-name <voiceName> and never passes --model
--count is not accepted on audio nodes and is never passed
Paid execution is handed off to dreamina-canvas-cli; this Skill never calls --run
Exit 20 / 21 continue via operation wait with the same submitId
The artifact is verified with SHA-256 and a plausibility check on duration vs narration length
